name: Warnings Triage
description: Read-only triage of the warnings Revit shows for the open project: groups them by type, ranks them by how many elements they touch, flags the ones a BIM coordinator should chase, and suggests a plain next step for each group.
author: AEC Model Bridge

commands.title: Review Revit Warnings (grouped, ranked, with next steps)

snapshot_id.description: Optional snapshot ID. Used only to turn Revit element ids into element UniqueIds.

coordinator_only.description: If true, only return the warning groups a BIM coordinator should chase (duplicate marks, overlapping elements, rooms not enclosed).

top.description: Maximum number of groups to return, biggest first.

max_elements_per_group.description: Maximum number of element ids listed per group (the full count is always reported).
